cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model used when a request runs in the cloud. Change it here without a new release.

device_char_limit.description: Texts longer than this many characters go straight to the cloud (the on-device model has a smaller input limit).

claim_grounding.description: Check this claim: true = live Google Search sources (needs a paid Gemini tier); false = a private 'how to check' answer plus search links.
